name: Normalize
note: Normalize(output, outputRstd<float>, inputMean<float>, inputVariance<float>, inputX, gamma, beta, sharedTmpBuffer, epsilon, NormalizePara). Given precomputed per-row mean/var: rstd=rsqrt(var+eps), output=(x-mean)*rstd*gamma+beta. The 3510 impl reads only para.{aLength,rLength,rLengthWithPadding}; no host tiling. mean=0,var=1,eps=0->rstd=1; x=1,gamma=1,beta=0->output=1.
